userMessage.content: Create a one-shot TypeScript script that announces zombies are incoming, reads the configured demo location, spawns exactly three ZOMBIE entities nearby, and sends a private confirmation to GoldennBullet. Request all required registered capabilities with narrow constraints and per-capability reasons. Await effects, handle an offline player explicitly, and make no claim of prior approval.
